name: LinkSwift
description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
one_liner: A browser userscript that grabs direct download links from Chinese cloud-storage services like Baidu and Aliyun, so files download faster without the official app's speed limits.
buyer: No legitimate business buyer — this serves individual users of the Chinese internet trying to speed up downloads from their own personal cloud-storage accounts.
business_use_cases: An individual user installs it personally to speed up their own downloads from Baidu or Aliyun cloud storage; this is not a business use case.
No credible B2B or monetizable use case was found; the project itself operates in a gray area and explicitly disclaims endorsing speed or quota circumvention.

money_ideas.idea: None found. The project explicitly disclaims profiting from or facilitating circumvention of these services' terms of service.

steal_this: There's nothing to build a legitimate business on here — it's a personal-use browser script that skirts cloud-storage providers' terms of service.
